literal: "Of this measure" that which is said one thing is not; of the guest measure-measure sacrifice's fruit.
translation: The benefit of the sacrifice of hospitality cannot be quantified as being "just this much". Its measure is exactly commensurate with the worth of the guests.
modern: விருந்தோம்பல் என்னும் வேள்வியின் பயன் இவ்வளவுதான் என்று அளவிட்டுக் கூற முடியாது. அது வந்த விருந்தினரின் தகுதிக்கு ஏற்ற அளவினைக் கொண்டதாகும்.
explanation: The couplet compares the act of hosting guests to a sacred sacrifice ('வேள்வி'). It states that the spiritual or moral benefit ('பயன்') of this hospitality cannot be restricted to a specific, quantifiable amount ('இனைத்துணைத்து'). Instead, the reward is directly proportional to the worth and quality of the guests ('விருந்தின் துணைத்துணை'). Thus, the true value of hospitality lies in the merit of those who are welcomed.
